subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'LUNGS' is written as ‘OXQJV’ and ‘POWER’ is written as ‘SRZHU’, how will 'ELOQUENT' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

'LUNGS' is written as ‘OXQJV’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/403595fbdee6c395b2ea5029aaef78d629b85c259e980120fcd191a4746f1af3.png] 

‘POWER’ is written as ‘SRZHU’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8676286f2aab8932bd5c2f12446d3866c5625fa525ffc95bd2ff0239e3783405.png] 

 Similarly, for 'ELOQUENT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2c9fc5780b4b1f7121ecc3a5423c4a7f34cc9c39bd565b109838b12a75f1745.png] 

‘ELOQUENT’ is written as ‘HORTXHQW’.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
